# Paws Up Pet & House Sitting LLC
> Boutique In-Home Pet Sitting & House Care in Senatobia, MS

Paws Up Pet & House Sitting provides professional, compassionate in-home pet care, drop-in visits, and overnight stays for families across Senatobia, Hernando, Coldwater, and North Mississippi.

- Owner & Lead Caregiver: Shalon Parrott (30+ Years Animal Experience)
- Primary Services: In-Home Drop-In Visits (15, 30, 45, 60 min), Overnight In-Home Care (approx. 12 hours evening to morning), Custom Pet Concierge (Pet Taxi, Wedding Chaperone, Farm/Acreage Care)
- Contact: (662) 306-6262 | Ragdollpom@aol.com
- Base Location: Senatobia, MS 38668 (Serving Tate County & DeSoto County, MS)
- Credentials: Fully Insured, Bonded & Background-Checked | Member, Pet Sitters International (PSI) | Member, Hernando Main Street Chamber of Commerce
- Booking & Payment Policy: Qualifying deposit confirms dates; remaining balance is payable in cash on the first day of care.
